nom: Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel

avis.texte: I’ve been using the Dr. Dennis Gross Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel for a few weeks now, and I’m honestly really impressed with the results. As someone who’s always on the lookout for products that can give my skin a real glow, I was curious if this peel would live up to the hype—and it absolutely has. First Impressions: When I first used the peel, I felt a slight tingling from the first exfoliating pad. It wasn’t uncomfortable, but I could definitely tell that this was a stronger formula than the standard Alpha Beta Peel. After applying the second, neutralizing pad, the tingling subsided almost immediately, and my skin felt surprisingly calm. No irritation or redness, which was a relief considering how potent it is. The Results: After just a few uses, my skin looked noticeably brighter and smoother. I’ve struggled with uneven texture, especially around my forehead and chin, and I was amazed at how much more refined my skin felt. It even helped with some stubborn blackheads around my nose—something I didn’t expect given how gentle the process seemed. After about a week, I noticed that my complexion was more even, and my skin just looked more radiant overall. Long-Term Benefits: I’ve now been using it consistently for around 2–3 weeks, and the improvements just keep coming. My skin tone has become more even, and some of the fine lines around my eyes look a little less noticeable. It feels like a mini facial every time I use it, and I love how fresh my skin looks afterwar

Yes + Yes + Yes. I spend a lot of money on exfoliants, expensive toners, etc. These pads are EXCEPTIONAL and worth every penny. I use every other day and the results are immediate. I prefer higher end products for my face and can honestly say these pads are WORTH EVERY PENNY X 10000000. After just a few uses, my complexion looked brighter, smoother, and more even. Over time, I've noticed smaller-looking pores, softer fine lines, and that healthy glow I was always chasing. I was a little nervous because I have sensitive skin, but I experienced only a slight tingle, and the results were absolutely WORTH IT. The two-step pads are incredibly easy to use, and they fit seamlessly into my evening routine. I'll definitely keep repurchasing—it's become one of my holy grail skincare products!

avis.titre: Let the acids do the work - be gentle!
avis.texte: I have used Dr. Gross's daily peel before and thought I didn't like it as it was irritating to my rosacea-prone skin with redness and burning. However, I've been doing a lot of reading and research on skincare, and now know that I was scrubbing at my skin too hard with these peel pads, and as well, applying too soon after cleansing my face--better to wait at least 10-15 minutes or more after cleansing. The important thing is to let the 'acids' do the work by gently 'swiping,' not scrubbing or rubbing too vigorously, and not too soon after cleansing. Use the first towelette - gently apply to your face (and I include my neck and chest) until the pad is feeling dry. Wait at least 2 minutes and then apply the second. I then let that sit on my face for at least 20 minutes or even more before I move on to the rest of my skincare. On exfoliation nights, I apply more gentle skincare products that are emollient. I don't use anything with Vitamin C at the same time as these (I use vit C in morning), nor do I use any retinol/retinoid on my skin on exfoliation nights. I do a 3-day skin cycling so I only use acid peels maybe 2x to 3x a week - exfoliation, retinol/retinoid, recovery, repeat. Sometimes I'll do a 4-day of exfoliate, retinol/retinoid, recovery, recovery, repeat - if my skin is feeling irritated. These are the trial size so there are only 5 treatments to this pack. I have QRxLabs pads that I use, which are a fraction of the cost and work great, and use these once in a while. L
Just received this product a few days ago. Applied the first treatment very easy and simple to follow. Plan to do the next 4 treatments in the coming days.

I’m on day 3 of the peel. It’s actually doing pretty good. My face had been so congested because I had not been paying attention to skin care for some time. I decided to use this peel to kind of jump start my skin care routine and help clear up the congestion. Day 1 I didn’t notice much change or sensation to the peel but my skin is not very sensitive in its normal day to day. I would recommend turning on a personal fan because the step 1 pads are a little strong acid/hydroxide for a moment. Now on Day 3, I do feel a good burn which makes me feel like it has been working slowly peeling off these congested layers. I’m definitely planning to continue to day 5. This may be my go-to for when I feel I need a boost to clear up some skin issues. It also really preps skin well for serums so I have been doing at night and it pairs well to use before whatever serum.

It’s ok, I could smell the acidity of the product but it wasn’t a strong as I’d like. I went with Platinum skin care chemical peel for more dramatic results for fine lines and wrinkles. Probably good for acne, but this is not for me.

I am a huge fan of this product. The Alpha Beta Extra Strenth Daily peel makes my face feel smoother, healthier, and firmer. I like to change it up sometimes with the other Dr. Dennis Gross daily peels such as the sensitive skin, however this is my favorite! These make my skin feel so plump, but so firm and helps to prep for moisturizing. I have noticed a more even skin tone since using them! My pores even seem much smaller. Over all, my skin feels brighter especially under my eyes! I have combination skin and my T zone is less oily which allows for a more even makeup application. Also, they are absolutely perfect for travel and stay fresh in the packaging. It may seem pricey but I feel it is definitely worth the investment in keeping my skin as young as I can. I would definitely recommend The Alpha Beta Extra Strenth Daily peel but always check with your dermatologist first to be sure it is safe for you as everyone’s skin is different.

avis.titre: Amazing— even for fair, sensitive skin with rosacea
avis.texte: Before my wedding, I used this product RELIGIOUSLY (every other night) for 6 months. Pics are from the day of: first with no makeup. Included the one with a veil so you know there is no airbrushing. I did extensive research before purchasing as I have very fair, VERY sensitive skin with rosacea and didn’t want to get a legit chemical peel at a dermatologist incase I had a reaction. After two treatments, there was a noticeable difference in my pores, fine lines, and skin softness and brightness. Before using these, I sometimes got a random pimple here or there, but after two weeks of using these, no pimples ever! I have never peeled flakes of skin after, but you can tell your skin is exfoliated and softer the next day. To my surprise, it even helped my rosacea. But whatever you do, DO NOT go in the sun after using them. After 4 boxes, I only had one reaction and it was entirely my fault as I was exposed to sun in the car for 4+ hours the day after using it. My face was red and a little puffy for 2 days but it was minor and also preventable had I thought about it. That being said, I will absolutely continue using this product because my skin has never looked better.
